[[File:FromtheDarkestWayoftheForce.jpg|thumb|right|Darth Wyyrlok's copy of ''From the Darkest Way of the Force'']]
'''''From the Darkest Way of the Force''''' was a [[Book/Legends|book]] of ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lore that was part of [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok's]] collection. All words appeared in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] characters and were in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]. It was written by [[Coqui Tanar]], according to its cover.

==Behind the scenes==
Text on the cover says "LO''[obscured]''FORMITIES". Presumably, the latter is supposed to be "DEFORMITIES", which is fitting, given that Wyyrlok is looking for an answer to [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Yorik-Kul|affliction]].
